```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(TSA)
library(astsa)
library(tseries)
library(TSstudio)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(forecast)
library(fpp2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)
library(patchwork)
library(prophet)
library(zoo)
```

---

# 1. Data Collection & Exploration

```{r}
content = read.csv("AB_NYC_2019.csv")
head(content)
str(content)
summary(content)
cat("Rows before cleaning:", nrow(content))

```


# 2. Data Cleaning

## 2.1 Check for Missing Values

```{r}
colSums(is.na(content))
content = content[!is.na(content$last_review), ]
cat("Rows after removing missing last_review:", nrow(content))

```

## 2.2 Check for Outliers in Price

```{r}
summary(content$price)
boxplot(content$price, main = "Raw Listing Price", ylab = "Price (USD)")
```

The boxplot reveals extreme outliers, the maximum is $10,000/night.
We also have listings with a price of $0, which are invalid entries.

```{r}
content = content[content$price > 0 & content$price <= 1000, ]
summary(content$price)
cat("Rows after price cleaning:", nrow(content), "\n")
boxplot(content$price, main = "Listing Price After Cleaning", ylab = "Price (USD)")
```

---

## 2.3 Build the Monthly Time Series

```{r}
content$last_review = as.Date(content$last_review)
content$year_month  = as.Date(format(content$last_review, "%Y-%m-01"))

monthly = content %>%
  group_by(year_month) %>%
  summarise(median_price = median(price), n = n()) %>%
  filter(n >= 10,
         year_month >= as.Date("2015-01-01"),
         year_month <= as.Date("2019-06-01")) %>%
  arrange(year_month)

monthly
```

```{r}
ts_data = ts(monthly$median_price, start = c(2015, 1), frequency = 12)
ts_data
autoplot(ts_data) +
  ggtitle("Monthly Median Airbnb Price - NYC (After Cleaning)") +
  xlab("Year") + ylab("Median Price (USD)")
```

---

## 2.4 Check for Outliers in the Monthly Time Series

```{r}
boxplot(ts_data, main = "Monthly Median Price - Boxplot", ylab = "Price (USD)")

ts_clean = tsclean(ts_data)
ts_clean

ts_data = ts_clean
autoplot(ts_data) +
  ggtitle("Final Cleaned Time Series") +
  xlab("Year") + ylab("Median Price (USD)")
```
---

# 4. Preprocessing & Stationarity Check

```{r}
adf.test(ts_data)
kpss.test(ts_data)

acf(ts_data,  main = "ACF - Original")
pacf(ts_data, main = "PACF - Original")
```

```{r}
log_ts = log(ts_data)
autoplot(log_ts) + ggtitle("Log-transformed Series") + ylab("log(Price)")

ts_diff = diff(log_ts)
autoplot(ts_diff) + ggtitle("Differenced Log Series")

adf.test(ts_diff)
kpss.test(ts_diff)
```

```{r}
acf(ts_diff,  main = "ACF - Differenced")
pacf(ts_diff, main = "PACF - Differenced")
```

```{r}
# Train / Validate / Test split
train = window(ts_data, end   = c(2017, 12))
val   = window(ts_data, start = c(2018,  1), end = c(2018, 6))
test  = window(ts_data, start = c(2018,  7))

train
val
test
```

---

# 5. Model Implementation

## ARIMA Model

```{r}
arima_model = auto.arima(log(train), seasonal = FALSE)
arima_model
summary(arima_model)
checkresiduals(arima_model)
```

```{r}
forecast_arima = forecast(arima_model, h = length(val) + length(test))
autoplot(forecast_arima) + ggtitle("ARIMA Forecast")

arima_pred = exp(forecast_arima$mean)
arima_pred
```

---

## SARIMA Model

```{r}
sarima_model = auto.arima(log(train), seasonal = TRUE, D = 1)
summary(sarima_model)
checkresiduals(sarima_model)
```

```{r}
forecast_sarima = forecast(sarima_model, h = length(val) + length(test))
autoplot(forecast_sarima) + ggtitle("SARIMA Forecast")

sarima_pred = exp(forecast_sarima$mean)
sarima_pred
```

---

## ETS Model

```{r}
ets_model = ets(train)
summary(ets_model)
checkresiduals(ets_model)
```

```{r}
forecast_ets = forecast(ets_model, h = length(val) + length(test))
autoplot(forecast_ets) + ggtitle("ETS Forecast")
forecast_ets
```

---

## Prophet Model

```{r}
df = data.frame(
  ds = monthly$year_month,
  y  = log(monthly$median_price)
)

train_df = df[1:(nrow(monthly) - length(test)), ]

model_prophet = prophet(train_df, yearly.seasonality = TRUE)

future           = make_future_dataframe(model_prophet, periods = length(test), freq = "month")
forecast_prophet = predict(model_prophet, future)
tail(forecast_prophet[c("ds", "yhat", "yhat_lower", "yhat_upper")])

plot(model_prophet, forecast_prophet)
prophet_plot_components(model_prophet, forecast_prophet)
```

---

# 6. Model Evaluation & Comparison

```{r}
h_total = length(val) + length(test)
n_val   = length(val)
n_test  = length(test)

actual_test = as.numeric(test)

arima_test  = as.numeric(arima_pred)[(n_val + 1):h_total]
sarima_test = as.numeric(sarima_pred)[(n_val + 1):h_total]
ets_test    = as.numeric(forecast_ets$mean)[(n_val + 1):h_total]
prophet_test = exp(tail(forecast_prophet$yhat, n_test))
```

```{r}
data.frame(
  Model = c("ARIMA", "SARIMA", "ETS"),
  AIC   = c(AIC(arima_model), AIC(sarima_model), AIC(ets_model)),
  BIC   = c(BIC(arima_model), BIC(sarima_model), BIC(ets_model))
)
```

```{r}
mae  = function(a, p) mean(abs(a - p))
rmse = function(a, p) sqrt(mean((a - p)^2))
mape = function(a, p) mean(abs((a - p) / a)) * 100

results = data.frame(
  Model = c("ARIMA", "SARIMA", "ETS", "Prophet"),
  RMSE  = c(rmse(actual_test, arima_test),
            rmse(actual_test, sarima_test),
            rmse(actual_test, ets_test),
            rmse(actual_test, prophet_test)),
  MAE   = c(mae(actual_test, arima_test),
            mae(actual_test, sarima_test),
            mae(actual_test, ets_test),
            mae(actual_test, prophet_test)),
  MAPE  = c(mape(actual_test, arima_test),
            mape(actual_test, sarima_test),
            mape(actual_test, ets_test),
            mape(actual_test, prophet_test))
)
results
```

```{r}
test_dates = monthly$year_month[(nrow(monthly) - n_test + 1):nrow(monthly)]

plot(test_dates, actual_test, type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 2,
     main = "Actual vs Forecasted - Test Period (Jul 2018 - Jun 2019)",
     xlab = "Date", ylab = "Median Price (USD)",
     ylim = range(c(actual_test, arima_test, sarima_test, ets_test, prophet_test)))

lines(test_dates, arima_test,   col = "red",    lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)
lines(test_dates, sarima_test,  col = "blue",   lty = 3, lwd = 1.5)
lines(test_dates, ets_test,     col = "green",  lty = 4, lwd = 1.5)
lines(test_dates, prophet_test, col = "orange", lty = 5, lwd = 1.5)

legend("topright",
       legend = c("Actual", "ARIMA", "SARIMA", "ETS", "Prophet"),
       col    = c("black", "red", "blue", "green", "orange"),
       lty    = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), lwd = 2)
```


The NYC Airbnb data required three cleaning steps before analysis:
- Rows with missing last_review dates (10,052) were removed as they could not be placed on a timeline.
- Listings with price = 0 (invalid) and price > 1000 (extreme outliers) were filtered out.
- tsclean() was applied to the final monthly series to handle any remaining outliers.

## Which Model Performed Best and Why?

**ETS is the best-performing model for this dataset.**

Based on all three test-set metrics, ETS(M, N, N) is the best-performing model for this dataset. It achieved the lowest RMSE (4.841), the lowest MAE (4.125), and the lowest MAPE (3.97%), meaning its forecasts were on average less than four percent away from the actual monthly median price. Its simplicity just a smoothing parameter and a multiplicative error structure turned out to be a strength rather than a weakness given the relatively small training window of 36 months. With limited data, a parsimonious model that adapts to recent price levels outperforms more complex seasonal models that require many cycles to calibrate.
